Content World 100 · CW100

Celebrating Christian Influence Impacting Africa & Beyond

Content World 100 (CW100) recognizes 100 Christian leaders, creators, educators, entrepreneurs, and culture-shapers from Africa, the United Kingdom, Europe, the British Virgin Islands, and Asia.

Africa United Kingdom Europe British Virgin Islands Asia
Attend Presentation Gala
Vision & Purpose

Why CW100?

Influence takes many forms across the Kingdom ecosystem.

It is expressed through ministry, enterprise, media storytelling, education, frontier innovation, social impact, governance, and institution-building.

CW100 exists to celebrate Christian voices whose work helps shape communities, industries, and the future of the continent and world.

Presentation Ceremony

Faith Nexus 2027 Presentation

The inaugural CW100 will be unveiled during Faith Nexus 2027 in Johannesburg. Official nominations and the global recognition shortlist will be announced on 29 October 2026.
